defs.def: to keep a particular quality, feature, etc; to make sure that sth is kept 保护；维护；保留

ex.s: Beyond visitor interaction, AI plays a crucial role in preserving priceless artworks.
ex.t: 除了访客互动，人工智能在保护无价艺术品方面也发挥着关键作用。

ex.s: Preserve the genes of endangered plants.
They preserve more traditions than they break.
ex.t: 他们可能制造的问题比解决的问题还多。
它应该得到很好的保护。

ex.s: He said that he had heard the calls to preserve the boxes and had seen how some of them were listed as historic buildings.
ex.t: 但Inglis最终自己买下了数百个，打算修复后出售。

ex.s: As the Kennedy Center’s artistic adviser for jazz, Moran hopes to widen the audience for jazz, make the music more accessible, and preserve its history and culture.
ex.t: 作为肯尼迪中心的爵士乐艺术顾问，莫兰希望扩大爵士乐的听众群，让这种音乐更容易被人接受，并保护其历史和文化。

ex.s: This new generation of artisans will not only help preserve traditional skills; the innovation they bring to the craft will also ensure that the art of clock repairing stands the test of time.
ex.t: 新一代工匠不仅将有助于保护传统技艺；他们给手艺带来的创新也将确保钟表修复艺术经得起时间的考验。

ex.s: Reason Preserve Promote Cypress The word is an example of a group/type I know.
ex.t: 理性 保护 促进 柏树 这个词是我所知道的一类/类型的例子。

ex.s: One must know how on object was made in order to preserve it.
ex.t: 人们必须了解一件物品是如何制作的才能保护它。

defs.def: to keep sth in its original state in good condition 维持 … 的原状；保存；保养

ex.s: How does Ms Young inspire you in her efforts to preserve Chinese Culinary traditions?
ex.t: 杨小姐如何激励你努力保存中国烹饪传统?.

ex.s: It’s as if the brain is preserving its most important memories.
ex.t: 就好像大脑在保存它最重要的记忆。

ex.s: Duck-billed platypus: The first scientists to examine a preserved platypus body judged it a fake in the late 18th century.
ex.t: 鸭嘴兽：最早检查一只保存完好的鸭嘴兽标本的科学家在18世纪末判定它是一个伪造品。

ex.s: Nevertheless, of all the characters I have known, perhaps Walden wears best, and best preserves its purity.
ex.t: 然而，在我所认识的所有人物中，也许瓦尔登的性格最经得起考验，也最能保持其纯洁。

ex.s: It is one of the largest and most well-preserved cities of the era, covering an area of 12 square kilometres.
ex.t: 它是那个时代规模最大、保存最完好的城市之一，占地 12 平方公里。

defs.def: to prevent sth, especially food, from decaying by treating it in a particular way 贮存；保鲜
to keep sb/sth alive, or safe from harm or danger 使继续存活；保护；保全

ex.s: A machine with a specific purpose has another quality, one that we usually associate with living things: a wish to preserve its own existence.
ex.t: 一台有特定用途的机器还有另一种品质，一种我们通常与生物联系在一起的品质：保全自身存在的愿望。

defs.def: an activity, a job, an interest, etc. that is thought to be suitable for one particular person or group of people （某人或群体活动、工作等的）专门领域
a type of jam made by boiling fruit with a large amount of sugar 果酱
a type of pickle made by cooking vegetables with salt or vinegar 腌菜；泡菜
an area of private land or water where animals and fish are kept for people to hunt 私人渔猎场（或保留地）

ex.s: Scents of the missing plants are preserved in the atmosphere.
ex.t: 森林和雪的气味变化有一个共同的潜在原因。

ex.s: Phil Blythe explains: “For many older people, particularly those living alone or in the country, driving is important for preserving their independence, giving them the freedom to get out and about without having to rely on others.”
ex.t: 菲尔·布莱斯解释道：“对许多老年人来说，特别是那些独居或在乡村生活的人来说，驾驶对于保持独立性非常重要，让他们能够自由出行而不必依赖他人。”
